import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivision
import MumfordLib.BarycentricSubdivisionVertices

/-!
# Support of barycentric subdivision chains

The recursive subdivision of an ordered simplex is spanned by its recursively
subdivided vertex lists. This connects the geometry of those lists to the
actual chain operator, including cancellation between signed faces.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {V : Type} {m n : ℕ}

/-- A linear operation sends a span of vertex generators into a submodule
whenever it sends each of those generators into that submodule. -/
theorem vertexListChain_span_comp_mem
    (s : Set (Fin (n + 1) → V)) {Y : ModuleCat ℤ}
    (f : (VertexListChainComplex V).X n ⟶ Y)
    (P : Submodule ℤ (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ Y))
    (hf : ∀ v ∈ s, vertexListChain v ≫ f ∈ P)
    {c : ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ (VertexListChainComplex V).X n}
    (hc : c ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (vertexListChain '' s)) : c ≫ f ∈ P := by
  have hle : Submodule.span ℤ (vertexListChain '' s) ≤
      P.comap (CategoryTheory.Linear.rightComp ℤ (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) f) := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact hf v hv
  exact hle hc

/-- The signed subdivision chain is spanned by its recursively produced lists.
The span allows cancellations between different faces. -/
theorem vertexListChain_subdivision_mem_span
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) :
    vertexListChain v ≫ barycentricSubdivision m n ∈
      Submodule.span ℤ (vertexListChain '' barycentricSubdivisionVertices m n v) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      change vertexListChain v ≫ 𝟙 _ ∈ _
      rw [Category.comp_id]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨v, rfl, rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [vertexListChain_barycentricSubdivision_succ, ← Category.assoc,
        ← Category.assoc, vertexListChain_boundary]
      simp only [Preadditive.sum_comp, Preadditive.zsmul_comp]
      apply Submodule.sum_mem
      intro i _
      apply Submodule.smul_mem
      apply vertexListChain_span_comp_mem
        (barycentricSubdivisionVertices m n (v ∘ i.succAbove))
        (vertexListCone (affineSimplexBarycenter v) n) _ ?_ (ih _)
      intro w hw
      rw [vertexListChain_cone]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, w, hw, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

/-- Chains spanned by ordered simplices with pairwise vertex distance at most
`D`. No diameter restriction is imposed on the union of their images. -/
def vertexListMeshSubmodule (m n : ℕ) (D : ℝ) :
    Submodule ℤ (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶
      (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).X n) :=
  Submodule.span ℤ (vertexListChain ''
    {v | ∀ i j, dist (v i) (v j) ≤ D})

theorem vertexListChain_mem_mesh
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) {D : ℝ}
    (hv : ∀ i j, dist (v i) (v j) ≤ D) :
    vertexListChain v ∈ vertexListMeshSubmodule m n D :=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩

theorem vertexListMeshSubmodule_mono {D E : ℝ} (h : D ≤ E) :
    vertexListMeshSubmodule m n D ≤ vertexListMeshSubmodule m n E := by
  apply Submodule.span_mono
  rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨v, fun i j => (hv i j).trans h, rfl⟩

/-- One subdivision contracts a generator's mesh bound. -/
theorem vertexListChain_subdivision_mem_mesh
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) {D : ℝ}
    (hD₀ : 0 ≤ D) (hD : ∀ i j, dist (v i) (v j) ≤ D) :
    vertexListChain v ≫ barycentricSubdivision m n ∈
      vertexListMeshSubmodule m n ((n : ℝ) / (n + 1) * D) := by
  apply (Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_mono (fun w hw =>
    barycentricSubdivisionVertices_dist_le v hw hD₀ hD)))
      (vertexListChain_subdivision_mem_span v)

/-- The mesh contraction extends linearly to chains. -/
theorem barycentricSubdivision_mesh_mem {D : ℝ} (hD₀ : 0 ≤ D)
    {c : ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶
      (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).X n}
    (hc : c ∈ vertexListMeshSubmodule m n D) :
    c ≫ barycentricSubdivision m n ∈
      vertexListMeshSubmodule m n ((n : ℝ) / (n + 1) * D) :=
  vertexListChain_span_comp_mem _ _ _
    (fun v hv => vertexListChain_subdivision_mem_mesh v hD₀ hv) hc

/-- After `k` subdivisions, each simplex has mesh bounded by the geometric
factor `(n / (n + 1)) ^ k`. -/
theorem barycentricSubdivision_pow_mesh_mem {D : ℝ} (hD₀ : 0 ≤ D)
    {c : ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶
      (VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))).X n}
    (hc : c ∈ vertexListMeshSubmodule m n D) (k : ℕ) :
    c ≫ (End.of (barycentricSubdivision m n)) ^ k ∈
      vertexListMeshSubmodule m n (((n : ℝ) / (n + 1)) ^ k * D) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using hc
  | succ k ih =>
      have h := barycentricSubdivision_mesh_mem (by positivity) ih
      simpa only [pow_succ', End.mul_def, Category.assoc, mul_assoc] using h

end Mumford.Analytic
